verdict.rationale: Justworks' own docs show a payroll-side flow at Pay > Make a Payment > Domestic, which suggests an ad-hoc payment entry point outside the regular run. However, the cited instructions only cover the 'Record a Payment' sub-option for fringe benefits provided outside Justworks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running an off-cycle payroll, coverage of bonuses, corrections, and termination/final pay use cases, scheduling and tax-handling details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
